[[Wizard's Infinite Mist Omnipotion]] is a reusable [[gizmo]] used to gain buffs in the [[Fractals of the Mists]].

== Mechanics ==
* As the name suggests, the gizmo is infinitely reusable.
* The buffs last for 2 hours, compared to 1 hour for the consumable potions.
* Applied automatically when interacting with a [[Mistlock Singularity]] if present in your [[inventory]] or [[Shared Inventory Slot]].
* The gizmo itself applies five stacks of [[Fractal Offensive]], [[Fractal Defensive]], and [[Fractal Mobility]]. This grants in total:
** 15% increased outgoing [[damage]]
** 25% decreased incoming damage
** 25% increased [[movement speed]]
** 50% increased [[endurance]] recharge
** +225 [[Toughness]], [[Vitality]], and [[Concentration]] (+15% boon duration) at 150 [[Agony Resistance]] with completion of [[Fractal Attunement Mastery]].
